story: Keynote by John Carmack at Oculus Connect 2014 [video]
text: Absolutely agreed on the mental processing speed and acute awareness of smaller details. Look at this point in the video:- [VIDEO] He has just opened the floor for questions, and the questioner does not have a microphone and hence audience cannot hear the question. John starts answering the question, but immediately recognizes the situation and then repeats the question for his audience.

story: John Carmack's BAFTA Introduction, Speech and Interview [video]
text: For something like a decade (2004~2005 until 2013), Carmack gave a fluent hours-long speech/discussion/brain-dump at QuakeCon. I doubt a few minutes's speech is something he needs "plenty of time to prepare and rehearse" for at this point. Recent examples: 2h50 2013 QuakeCon keynote [LINK] 2h20 2014 SMU talk [LINK] 1h30 2014 Oculus Connect keynote [VIDEO]
